# `/tagged-objects` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /tagged-objects/v1

`listTaggedObjectsV1` — List tagged objects

This API returns a list of all tagged objects.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage, idn:tag:read
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: objectRef.id: eq, in; objectRef.type: eq, in; tagName: eq, in — e.g. `tagName eq "BU_FINANCE"`
- Returns 200: array of taggedobject

### POST /tagged-objects/v1

`setTagToObjectV1` — Add tag to object

This adds a tag to an object.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- Body (application/json): taggedobject
- Returns 201: no body

### GET /tagged-objects/v1/{type}

`listTaggedObjectsByTypeV1` — List tagged objects by type

This API returns a list of all tagged objects by type.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage, idn:tag:read
- Parameters:
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_PROFILE, APPLICATION, CAMPAIGN, ENTITLEMENT, IDENTITY, ROLE, SOD_POLICY, SOURCE — The type of tagged object to retrieve.
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: objectRef.id: eq; objectRef.type: eq — e.g. `objectRef.id eq "2c91808568c529c60168cca6f90c1313"`
- Returns 200: array of taggedobject

### GET /tagged-objects/v1/{type}/{id}

`getTaggedObjectV1` — Get tagged object

This gets a tagged object for the specified type.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage, idn:tag:read
- Parameters:
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_PROFILE, APPLICATION, CAMPAIGN, ENTITLEMENT, IDENTITY, ROLE, SOD_POLICY, SOURCE — The type of tagged object to retrieve.
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the object reference to retrieve.
- Returns 200: taggedobject

### PUT /tagged-objects/v1/{type}/{id}

`putTaggedObjectV1` — Update tagged object

This updates a tagged object for the specified type.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- Parameters:
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_PROFILE, APPLICATION, CAMPAIGN, ENTITLEMENT, IDENTITY, ROLE, SOD_POLICY, SOURCE — The type of tagged object to update.
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the object reference to update.
- Body (application/json): taggedobject
- Returns 200: taggedobject

### DELETE /tagged-objects/v1/{type}/{id}

`deleteTaggedObjectV1` — Delete object tags

Delete all tags from a tagged object.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- Parameters:
  - `type` (path, required) — one of ACCESS_PROFILE, APPLICATION, CAMPAIGN, ENTITLEMENT, IDENTITY, ROLE, SOD_POLICY, SOURCE — The type of object to delete tags from.
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the object to delete tags from.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /tagged-objects/v1/bulk-add

`setTagsToManyObjectsV1` — Tag multiple objects

This API adds tags to multiple objects.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): bulkaddtaggedobject
- Returns 200: array of bulktaggedobjectresponse

### POST /tagged-objects/v1/bulk-remove

`deleteTagsToManyObjectV1` — Remove tags from multiple objects

This API removes tags from multiple objects.

- Scopes: idn:tag:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): bulkremovetaggedobject
- Returns 204: no body
